text: 840 ParseFromLine validates delimiters, sender length, date length and date parse before assigning either output. An accepted sender need not be an email address. Its all-or-neither assignment prevents a valid sender from being paired with an invalid or old date. Use local temporary results and commit the related outputs after the whole parse succeeds.
title: Commit parsed envelope fields together after validation
